basic_company.eventDescription: One company found hiring matching your skill keywords, with company name, role count, and posting dates. Does not meet the qualified tier rules (no working website with MX, or below the minimum postings bar).

qualified_hiring_company.eventDescription: One company that passed all qualification rules: at least the configured minimum number of matching senior level postings, working website that resolves, and valid MX record on the company domain. Includes velocity score, role mix, top skills, and likely contact email patterns. First 3 qualified rows per run are free so you can validate output.
